items.author: fxtrader
items.new_information: 上调2027年云开支至1.3万亿并给出科技债交易方向

evidence.quote: 美银首席策略师Michael Hartnett在最新一期周报中，将2026年中期选举定性为“AI股票集中度见顶”的历史节点，上调明年超大规模云厂商资本开支预期，预示未来现金流恶化。美银还为明年初债务上限做准备，看多黄金。
Hartnett的市场逻辑是，云计算大厂资本开支高企，现金流急剧恶化（美银一周内将2027年超大规模云厂商资本开支从1.2万亿美元上调至1.3万亿）。债券市场期待AI资本开支放缓；科技债券将跑赢科技股，利空芯片、云计算建设端，利好AI使用方资产负债表。
在宏观交易方面，美银押注黄金，警惕债务上限危机，理由是2027年2月美国或将触及41.1万亿美元债务上限，而历史上前两次债务上限博弈前三个月黄金大幅上涨，黄金从当前约4000美元起算，有望在债务上限博弈高峰期触及4500至4700美元区间。
在中期选举后，Hartnett的交易清单方向是黄金 > 石油、收益率下行、科技债券 > 科技股、消费股 > 能源股、小盘股 > 垄断股、做多欧洲、做多中国科技股。

evidence.quote: 1. DC available chain (current PQ roadmap) only has a few hundred validators in the hot path of each slot. Consensus time ~= log(validator count), so going from 30k vals -> 500 is plausibly a 2x speed boost.
2. Erasure coded P2P improves expected propagation time of big objects with no downside except some code complexity (which is manageable, esp given that this is not consensus code)

3. Few-slot finality. PQ sig aggregation is able to handle a message from every validator per round, and even at very conservative params (eg. ~5 rounds of aggregation, 1m validators) current math/simulations imply finality in under a minute (compare: 2.5 epochs = 16 min avg finality today)
So effectively, significant efficiency gains are part of the (currently understood) PQ security roadmap "for free"

items.summary: Yoshihiko_ICKW等研究Hyperliquid 28币美元中性资金费率carry：约2.4年全样本中纯FR carry（MV）年化-2.9%，高FR币相对上涨的损失约为FR收入1.25倍；动量为主信号费前年化+8.2%至8.5%。全期间费后SR取决于执行：taker基准-0.07、理想maker 0.46；美元中性仍有加密市场beta。
items.author: Yoshihiko_ICKW
items.event: Yoshihiko_ICKW等发表Hyperliquid资金费率carry策略研究
items.new_information: 纯FR carry被高FR币相对上涨抵消而为负；动量为主信号费前为正，全期间费后成绩随taker/maker执行假设变号

evidence.quote: Perpetual先物（無期限先物）では、FRがロングとショートの間で決済されます（正のFRではロングがショートへ支払い、負のFRでは逆）。本研究では、FRを毎時決済するオンチェーン取引所Hyperliquidの28銘柄で、Perpetualだけで構成したドルニュートラルなFRキャリーを分析しました。銘柄間のFR差から得られる収入が、相対価格の変化と売買コストを反映した後にどれだけ残るかを検証しています。
・全期間サンプル：8時間足、2024年2月19日〜2026年8月2日の約2.4年。直近サンプル：1時間足、2026年1月17日〜8月3日の約6.5か月。
・シグナルは過去30日の平均価格リターンμと平均FRの合成「μ−λ×平均FR」。λ=0は価格モメンタムのみ、λ→∞は純FRキャリーに対応します。
・全期間・費用控除前の年率リターンは、MV DNが+8.2%（λ=0）、+8.5%（λ=1）と正だった一方、純FRキャリーはMVで−2.9%、分位で−4.0%と負でした。
・MVの純FRキャリーの−2.9%は、FRのインカム収入+11.7%と価格リターン−14.6%から成ります。共通のFR水準は消えるため、この収入は銘柄別FRのクロスセクション差から生じています。
・価格相殺比率は14.6/11.7で約1.25。高FR銘柄の相対価格上昇による損失が、FR収入1単位当たり約1.25単位に達しました（命題1のκ>1に対応しますが、κを独立に推定した値ではありません）。
・MV DN（λ=1、出来高で絞った流動性制限ユニバース）の費用控除後SRは、taker基準で全期間−0.07（スプレッド3倍で−0.48）、直近+0.44。理想化maker（手数料1.5bp、スプレッド支払いなし）では全期間0.46、直近1.00でした。
・適用範囲は2026年8月の取得時点で選んだ固定28銘柄と定率配分指数で、ドルニュートラルでも暗号資産市場へのベータは残ります。

evidence.quote: Every individual change was reasonable. Together they produced a perfect * == * authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123158, nicknamed *sshole). Fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2 and Alpine packages.

A newly disclosed vulnerability dubbed *sshole has been discovered in OpenSSH installations using musl libc, potentially allowing attackers to bypass authentication and gain access to accounts that should reject password logins entirely.

The flaw affects certain configurations of Alpine Linux, OpenWrt, Buildroot, and Yocto where PAM is disabled and password authentication remains enabled. Under specific conditions, attackers can authenticate to locked accounts using arbitrary passwords between 257 and 1,024 characters.
The researcher demonstrated that affected Alpine Linux cloud images could allow attackers to gain root privileges through a passwordless administrative account.
OpenSSH 10.6p2 addresses the issue. Administrators are urged to update immediately or disable SSH password authentication until patches can be applied.

evidence.quote: According to The Information, NVIDIA has long lobbied hard against proposals to restrict Chinese companies’ access to its latest chips through overseas cloud providers. But since the scandal surrounding Jensen Huang broke, that lobbying appears to carry less weight in Washington.

The fallout has reportedly made it easier to advance three bills. The MATCH Act would restrict shipments of lithography equipment to China. The Overwatch Act would give Congress greater oversight of the Commerce Department’s decisions to approve AI chip sales to countries such as China. The Chip Security Act would require AI chips to have built-in tracking
capabilities.

The National Defense Authorization Act is expected to pass before the new Democratic-led Congress convenes in January. That gives Republican leaders an incentive to help move the legislation forward now, while they still have more say over what goes into the final bill.

And as of last week, Reuters reports that roughly 600,000 H200s are sitting in Hong Kong because Beijing won't approve large-scale imports of a chip that is still better than anything China's own industry makes at scale.

Yes, Chinese AI labs still want Nvidia chips. Gray market prices for H200 servers have roughly tripled over the past year. But that is exactly the point. Beijing is willing to impose real costs on its own AI labs to avoid dependence on American GPUs, which tells you how Beijing views GPU imports: not as a gift, but as a threat to its own ambitions.

Maybe, just maybe, selling China GPUs that trail our own state of the art, so that Chinese developers stay “addicted” to American GPUs and China doesn't build an alternative AI hardware ecosystem that we have no control or influence over *and* that China could share over time with our adversaries, was actually a smart, pro-American national defense policy.

evidence.quote: 这不是段子，而是沃顿商学院教授 Ethan Mollick 用 Anthropic 最新模型 Claude Fable 5.2 做的一场实验。
第二天，规则手册已经有 84 节。到了第十二天，这套管理制度膨胀到 204 节、8.75 万个英文单词。
